# PFP (Aust) Pty Ltd

> 100% Australian-owned supplier of engineered piping solutions, fittings, valves, and custom-fabricated equipment for the energy, mining, and chemical processing industries. Founded 1987. Head office in Bibra Lake, Western Australia.

PFP (Aust) Pty Ltd (also known as PFP Aust, or simply PFP) is a Perth-based industrial supplier specialising in engineered piping. The company supplies bulk piping, exotic alloys, fluoropolymer-lined systems, valves, and custom heat exchangers to Owners & Operators, EPCs, and fabricators across Australia. PFP was founded in 1987 and is currently 100% Australian-owned, having been re-acquired by founder Paul Montague from UMW Holdings Bhd in February 2019. Michael Ward serves as General Manager (appointed December 2020). The company is ISO 9001:2015 certified by Bureau Veritas (certificate AU005622-1).

## Products

- [Pipe Fittings & Valves](https://pfp.com.au/products/pipe-fittings-valves) — comprehensive range in carbon steel, stainless and exotic alloys
- [Linepipe & Coating Solutions](https://pfp.com.au/products/linepipe-coating) — API 5L linepipe with FBE, 3LPE, and concrete weight coating
- [Reinforced Thermoplastic Pipe (RTP)](https://pfp.com.au/products/reinforced-thermoplastic) — spoolable, corrosion-resistant; up to 110+°C; 15,000+ km manufacturing experience
- [PTFE Lined Piping Systems](https://pfp.com.au/products/composite-lined) — PTFE, PFA, PVDF, PP, HDPE, ETFE lined piping for chemical processing
- [PFP-RX Wear Resistant Piping](https://pfp.com.au/products/pfp-rx-abrasion) — up to 10x service life vs carbon steel; 50–900 mm; for slurry, tailings, mineral transport
- [Bi-Metal Piping Solutions](https://pfp.com.au/products/bi-metal) — CRA clad pipe and mechanically lined pipe for sour service and subsea
- [Heat Exchangers, Parts & Fabrication](https://pfp.com.au/products/heat-exchangers) — custom-built and replacement units in stainless, duplex, titanium, Hastelloy, Inconel
- [Specialty Fabrication & Forged Items](https://pfp.com.au/products/specialty-fabrication) — modular spooling, subsea structures, structural and pressure equipment
